## Segment summary
The video begins with a close-up of a small, black, homemade robot on a wooden desk, its screen displaying animated eyes. The robot's display cycles through various expressions while text overlays appear. The scene then cuts to a man in a black hoodie speaking directly to the camera in what appears to be a home office or studio.

## Segment summary
A man in a black hoodie sits in a room, speaking directly to the camera while holding a small microphone. He gestures with his hands as he presents information about a product, mentioning his website, build files, STL files, wiring diagrams, and assembly instructions. A promotional banner appears, stating that buying the V1 build files includes future versions for free. He also mentions having made "Rocky's code" completely.
